scope: student-tracker only; one-student prototype; no fresh live API verification

definitions.loaded: Selected inputs mapped for the prototype; global limits still apply.
definitions.partial: Mapped inputs have a known timing, completeness or interpretation gap.
definitions.missing: A required loader, field or source contract is absent.

tasks.limitation: A due to-do is a timetable proxy. Student-auth scope and current-state history limits apply.
tasks.next_step: Retain the proxy label; validate other students and roster coverage before cohort use.
tasks.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

task_deadlines.limitation: updatedAt is not completedAt; later edits can change apparent deadline adherence.
task_deadlines.next_step: Obtain a completion timestamp or explicitly accept and label the approximation.
task_deadlines.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

student_inputs.limitation: Creating a manual to-do or updating a done task is a proxy for filling academic inputs.
student_inputs.next_step: Confirm this proxy with Alcovia; do not equate it with the advisor checklist.
student_inputs.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

focus.limitation: The poll runs at 23:55 IST so /today is still the day being captured; sessions after 23:55 and a missed run are not recoverable at session level. Daily history gives per-day totals only (date, score, session count, minutes), no session ids or failure reasons. Pit history has id/type/timestamp/durationSeconds in code, but start-vs-end timestamp and ID equivalence are unverified.
focus.next_step: Confirm /today at 23:55 IST returns that day on the live service; pit-history looks like a mentor-session marker (sessionId, markedAt, sessionType), not a focus-session source, so a session-level backfill is not available.
focus.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

calendar.limitation: No calendar status read; current upserts preserve nulls. Historical connection dates are unavailable.
calendar.next_step: Add status snapshots and first-observed transition rules; retention becomes measurable only after the observation window.
calendar.evidence_level: client code only for candidate read/submit contract; usable submitted data unverified

wearable_connection.limitation: Dates are first observed; reconnect episodes are collapsed. needsReconnect/lastSyncAt do not determine this connection field.
wearable_connection.next_step: Confirm retention semantics and observation window; keep connection separate from healthy syncing.
wearable_connection.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

wellness.limitation: Daily poll has no wellness loader or populated real fixture. The separate synthetic manual demo verifies Whoop/manual separation, sleep units, nulls and KPI behavior (n8n/code/wellness.js). Only Whoop integration is evidenced.
wellness.next_step: Confirm populated real history/daily responses, day semantics, completeness and corrections before integrating the tested synthetic mapper; other brands still need actual integrations.
wellness.evidence_level: client code plus previously reported empty live responses; populated shape unverified

study_plan.limitation: This measures whether both hours are set, not whether the plan is good or followed. The normalizer rounds reported hours.
study_plan.next_step: Confirm fractional-hour handling and per-grade planning policy before treating this as a quality measure.
study_plan.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

study_hours.limitation: Daily snapshots are mapped. Accuracy against elapsed-quarter pace is an assumption; reported live actual hours were zero, and free-text subject names need normalization.
study_hours.next_step: Verify a populated actual-hours example and subject mapping; agree pace-accuracy interpretation.
study_hours.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

syllabus.limitation: The API gives running totals; denominator consistency and the configured academic-quarter pace remain assumptions.
syllabus.next_step: Cross-check totals and zero-chapter behavior; confirm the 25%-per-quarter pace and enrollment denominator.
syllabus.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

sessions.limitation: Only mapped kinds are loaded. A past start time is inferred held, not confirmed delivery. Student-visible records may omit cohort events. Policy targets are configured, not fetched each run.
sessions.next_step: Verify completion/cancellation semantics, event visibility and per-grade policy against monthly-progress/admin delivery data.
sessions.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

attendance.limitation: Only the signed-in participant is loaded. Participation means invited=true; the full invitation roster and denominator are unverified.
attendance.next_step: Confirm participant/invitee semantics and cohort permissions; reconcile against attendance totals.
attendance.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

nps.limitation: This is the API event-level value divided by 10, not a recomputed Net Promoter Score. It does not require the feedback table.
nps.next_step: Confirm the upstream meaning and label; test with feedback empty.
nps.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

quiz_events.limitation: Daily poll has no quiz mapping. A separate synthetic manual demo exists (n8n/code/quizzes.js); taken-only history cannot identify held-but-skipped or cancelled quizzes.
quiz_events.next_step: Define event ID/status/timestamp mapping and schedule capture; obtain a populated example before claiming real coverage.
quiz_events.evidence_level: client code plus previously reported empty live responses; populated shape unverified

quiz_attempts.limitation: Daily poll has no attempt loader or populated real fixture. A separate synthetic manual demo verifies event linkage and incomplete/completed attempts (n8n/code/quizzes.js).
quiz_attempts.next_step: Confirm populated real responses, history completeness, retakes and corrections before integrating the tested synthetic mapper.
quiz_attempts.evidence_level: client code plus previously reported empty live responses; populated shape unverified

session_feedback.limitation: Daily poll has no feedback loader. Separate synthetic submitted-feedback demo verifies mapping and KPIs; admin read permissions, kind coverage and populated real responses remain unverified. Pending lists are not submitted history.
session_feedback.next_step: Request authorized admin access or an export; map each feedback kind separately and retain only has_comment, not comment text.
session_feedback.evidence_level: client code only for candidate read/submit contract; usable submitted data unverified

evidence.match: How would you rate the pace

roadmap_feedback.limitation: Question meanings are evidenced: q1 pace, q2 investment, q3 confidence. The synthetic demo verifies these mappings through a proposed export, but no real submitted-roadmap read source is established.
roadmap_feedback.next_step: Find an authorized readable record/export with stable IDs, submittedAt, kind and the three ratings; a submit endpoint is not a loader.
roadmap_feedback.evidence_level: client code only for candidate read/submit contract; usable submitted data unverified

endpoints: Proposed form/export; no existing source established

evidence.match: Social work, entrepreneurship and summer program have no form

proposed_feedback.limitation: Social work, entrepreneurship and summer-support ratings use a proposed synthetic export in the manual demo. No real collection source or feedback-sending workflow is established.
proposed_feedback.next_step: Agree the rating question, cadence, owner, consent/access and event linkage before implementing a collection path.
proposed_feedback.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

additional_events.limitation: The current kind map excludes peer_session, branding_shoot, podcast, competition, parent_workshop, trip, social_work, summer_support and entrepreneurship_checkin.
additional_events.next_step: Obtain real lists/fields/statuses and stable app-student ID mappings or verify an authorized backend source; do not invent workspace IDs.
additional_events.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

publishing.limitation: Publication dates and views are hardcoded null. Current view counts cannot reconstruct historical reach.
publishing.next_step: Specify the publishing system, clip/event linkage, metrics access and snapshot policy.
publishing.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

groups.limitation: Group IDs are hardcoded null; group counts cannot be recovered just by adding social-work events.
groups.next_step: Obtain stable group IDs and membership/invitation records; verify the assumed group size.
groups.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

outcomes.limitation: Application outcomes are hardcoded null; event attendance does not establish application submission or acceptance.
outcomes.next_step: Agree submitted/accepted states, source owner and update timestamps, linked to student and support event.
outcomes.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

goals.limitation: Quarterly/monthly creation and completion use first-observed dates, not historical timestamps. Some due dates are null. Venture becomes entrepreneurship but may not mean the agreed startup-plan artifact.
goals.next_step: Confirm categories and artifact semantics. Keep observed-vs-actual dates explicit; do not claim exact historical deadline adherence.
goals.evidence_level: fixture-backed mapping; previous live observations documented, not rechecked

social_goals.limitation: No social_work category mapping exists, although the schema and KPI require it.
social_goals.next_step: Identify the milestone source and stable student/goal IDs; agree deadline and completion fields.
social_goals.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

chapters.limitation: Task/revision/score fields exist in static code; prior notes report populated tasks but empty scores. The checked-in ChapterSchema does not establish planned_month, stage-change timestamp, timed-paper evidence or exact five-stage semantics. Earlier notes claim task completedAt from live data, but no raw sample is checked in.
chapters.next_step: Obtain sanitized chapter/task/score and planning samples; resolve subject/quarter lookups, planned month, NotRequired, threshold boundaries, contiguous stages and change timestamps. Do not use poll time as student activity.
chapters.evidence_level: client code plus previously reported populated tasks and empty scores; planning/stage-change fields unresolved

evidence.match: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS advisor_inputs

advisor_inputs.limitation: No list, custom-field IDs, completion events or source rows have been seen. A roster of expected duties is needed to represent not-done, not just completed tasks.
advisor_inputs.next_step: Agree expected duty cadence and owner; map real task/custom-field IDs and student IDs; reconcile planned and completed duties.
advisor_inputs.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

evidence.match: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_targets

exam_targets.limitation: Actual-score code is term-oriented; targets and an exact formative/unit_test/mid_term mapping are unknown. The schema cannot distinguish repeated exams or years. The scorecard selects formative only.
exam_targets.next_step: Obtain targets and actuals for an identified exam/year; agree exam-type mapping, score units and schema grain before loading.
exam_targets.evidence_level: proposed or incomplete source; actual access/field mapping unknown

kpis.name: To-dos done on their due date
Posted clips reaching the view target (proxy)
Check-in: confidence the roadmap leads to the goals (average / 5)
Chapters covered against the syllabus pace
Rigour checks done by the advisor
Sprints made when a timeline was missed
Students still working through their chapters (proxy)
Chapters from past months fully complete
Exam scores at or above target
